description: Audit logging and compliance configuration for the AI trading protocol. Every trade lifecycle transition and risk decision must emit an event conforming to this spec.

eventTypes.name: trade_submitted
eventTypes.description: Emitted when an agent creates a new trade intent.

eventTypes.name: trade_validated
eventTypes.description: Emitted after risk policy validation completes, pass or fail.

eventTypes.name: trade_pending_approval
eventTypes.description: Emitted when a trade is routed for human approval.

eventTypes.name: trade_approved
eventTypes.description: Emitted when a human approver signs off on a trade.

eventTypes.name: trade_rejected
eventTypes.description: Emitted when a trade is rejected, whether by risk policy or a human approver.

eventTypes.name: trade_executed
eventTypes.description: Emitted when an order is submitted to the venue and receives an execution response.

eventTypes.name: trade_settled
eventTypes.description: Emitted when a trade reaches its terminal settled state.

eventTypes.name: trade_error
eventTypes.description: Emitted for any unexpected failure during trade processing (connectivity, auth, venue outage, etc).

retentionPolicy.description: Audit records must be retained long enough to satisfy applicable financial recordkeeping requirements.

complianceReporting.description: Periodic reporting requirements derived from accumulated audit events.
